scope: exact pointwise arbitrary-domain-torsion no-go and sparsest B=10 output-bundle connection repair for the complete candidate-bound 11x9x9 scalar-Hessian high-field-10 D2 subslice; no covariant-action origin, complete 11x153x153 D2F, full high-atom identity, global H7, PDE, lifespan, theory rejection, or observation

theorem.conclusion: Arbitrary torsion of the scalar-Hessian domain connection cannot repair the registered one-form. A sparse output-bundle connection does repair its complete 11x9x9 high-field-10 derivative subslice pointwise at the registered reference.
theorem.minimality: six distinct output rows carry curl, so every repair needs support in at least six output rows; the registered connection uses exactly six coefficients
